title: Global Genius booking: claim-level and item-level states (no Retry)
walkthroughSteps: Claim level: Claim Overview shows a banner only when something is wrong (AC-08, AC-09). The FNOL success page and the Approvals page are deliberately unchanged.
Before submit: Make payment and Add reserve run one shared list of checks (AC-10 to AC-16).
After approval: every reserve, payment and recovery shows its booking state in one status column (AC-01 to AC-05).
Only failures someone has to fix need attention: a task for the handler, or a note that Finance is on it (AC-02, AC-03, AC-07). No Retry button (DESIGN DECISION GG-1).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Payments list shows every status in one status column
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The Payments list has **one Status column** that walks each payment from approval to booking: Draft, Pending, Requires amendment, Rejected, then **Booking in progress**, **Booking delayed**, **Booked** or **Needs fixing**. There is **no Retry button** anywhere (DESIGN DECISION GG-1).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Make payment cannot be submitted while the claim is not in GG
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Opening **Make payment** shows the hold message at the top and the **Submit** button is disabled; the form can still be filled in.

preconditions.text: Make payment opens from Financial > Payments

acceptanceCriteria.statement: While the claim is still being set up, work carries on and items wait
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: With the claim **still being set up**, Make payment shows an info note that you can submit and it will be booked once the claim is ready; approved items show **Waiting for claim**.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Make payment stops a payment in a currency with no reserve
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Choosing **USD** on Make payment (all reserves are EUR) shows **there's no USD reserve to pay from** and blocks Submit.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Make payment warns about a limit breach inline and asks for a reason
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Entering an amount above what's left on the limit shows an **inline warning with a reason field** (no full-screen modal, BMPCC-20953). Submit works once a reason is given.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Add reserve uses the same warning list as Make payment
